name: Superbia
source:
Superbia is a free BL dating sim video game. It is inspired by a roleplay on the Dragon Age universe. You play Cassian, a blood mage forced to flee his home and travel with a group of companions around the world. Now you have the freedom to choose your fate and your companions' as well. Will you bring chaos or justice?

[From [url=http://superbiablgame.tumblr.com/]Superbia Official Website - Tumblr[/url]]

Note: Project canceled (http://superbiablgame.tumblr.com/post/163714242224/superbia-dropped)
translation:
《Superbia》是一款免费的BL恋爱模拟游戏，灵感来自以《龙腾世纪》世界为背景的角色扮演活动。你将扮演血法师Cassian。他被迫逃离家乡，与一群伙伴一同游历世界。如今，你可以自由选择自己与伙伴们的命运。你会带来混乱，还是伸张正义？

[来源：[url=http://superbiablgame.tumblr.com/]Superbia官方Tumblr网站[/url]]

注：项目已取消（http://superbiablgame.tumblr.com/post/163714242224/superbia-dropped）。
